item.title: A message from Mr. Vonesch:
item.description: Any high school students interested in helping out with the Advent Liturgy next week, either for reading, decorating, or behind the scenes support, please come to the chapel today to sign up. Thank you!

item.title: A message from Web Crew:
item.description: We are holding a raffle for the Christmas Angel Program, open to the whole school! It starts Tomorrow and ends December 7th. You can buy tickets at lunch time starting tomorrow for $2 for one ticket or $5 for 3, cash only. The raffle is for a basket valued at $200! All the money goes to families in need this Christmas. Thank you STA!
